Markets.title: Stocks in news: Infosys, Mazagon Dock, Fortis Healthcare, JSW Energy and Kalpataru Projects
Markets.summary: Indian stock markets rebounded on September 16 with gains in the Nifty and Sensex following increased investments in banking and major stocks. Infosys and Mazagon Dock are drawing investor attention due to recent corporate developments.

Markets.title: Pre-market action: Here's the trade setup for today's session
Markets.summary: Indian benchmark indices closed marginally higher following a volatile trading session and a weakening rupee. Meanwhile, the US Federal Reserve raised its main interest rate for the first time in three years, causing US stock markets to slip.

Markets.title: Retail investors shift from secondary market to IPOs in July-August, selling Rs 5,674 crore
Markets.summary: Indian retail investors sold Rs 5,674 crore of equities in the secondary market during July and August to book profits. Concurrently, they redirected these funds into primary market IPOs to capitalize on strong listing gains.

Markets.title: Shriram Finance plans $500 million bond buyback
Markets.summary: Shriram Finance plans to buy back $500 million of its April 2027 and April 2028 bonds at a slight premium to current trading prices. The company aims to reduce its borrowing costs through this tender offer, which is its first since MUFG acquired a stake earlier this year.

Markets.title: NSE IPO attracts 150+ anchor investors, raises Rs 6,746 crore
Markets.summary: The National Stock Exchange raised Rs 6,746.18 crore from over 150 anchor investors for its initial public offering. Overseas funds accounted for 43 percent of the stocks allocated in this category, with domestic institutional investors also contributing significantly.

Markets.title: Fed raises rates despite Trump pressure, signals another hike likely in 2026
Markets.summary: The US Federal Reserve raised interest rates by 25 basis points to combat ongoing inflation and reach its two percent goal. Officials signal at least one more rate hike is likely in 2026, a move expected to displease President Donald Trump.

Geo-Political.title: US interest rates raised for first time in three years
Geo-Political.summary: The US Federal Reserve raised interest rates for the first time in three years in a unanimous decision. The rate hike occurred despite fierce opposition from President Donald Trump, who had publicly called for a cut.

Geo-Political.title: Snapchat 'willing to implement' daily time limits for teens, boss tells BBC
Geo-Political.summary: Snapchat CEO Evan Spiegel told the BBC that the company is willing to implement daily time limits for teenage users. He stated that this change would represent an important step forward for the social media industry.

Geo-Political.title: Photos show widespread damage at US sites from Iranian attacks
Geo-Political.summary: CBS News obtained photos showing widespread damage at U.S. sites following Iranian attacks. The images reveal a wrecked air force plane and destroyed buildings.

Geo-Political.title: EU chief backs plan for Canada to become 'associate member'
Geo-Political.summary: The European Union chief supports a proposal for Canada to become an associate member of the EU. In response to this plan, US President Trump has threatened to cut trade with the European Union.

Geo-Political.title: US House votes to hold billionaire Epstein associate Leon Black in contempt
Geo-Political.summary: The US House voted to hold billionaire Leon Black in contempt. The vote occurred because Black refused to appear and provide documents related to his business ties with convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein.

Geo-Political.title: Eight children among 21 killed after war-damaged Gaza building collapses, rescuers say
Geo-Political.summary: A war-damaged, six-storey building collapsed in Gaza City, killing 21 people, including eight children. About 10 families had reportedly been living in the structure, which was struck by an Israeli attack last year.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: An online course creator recently discovered that ChatGPT recommended their WordPress SaaS course as the top result without any paid advertising. This experiment demonstrates how AI optimization (AIO) is beginning to rival traditional search engine optimization (SEO) for organic traffic.

AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has evolved into a generative AI platform that allows users to create digital content. The tool also provides features for creators to share and monetize their AI-generated work.

Data & Insights.title: US Fed raises interest rates as Kevin Warsh bucks Donald Trump to control inflation
Data & Insights.summary: The US Federal Reserve unanimously raised interest rates by 25 basis points to a range of 3.75-4.00% under Chair Kevin Warsh. The central bank also indicated plans for at least one more rate increase later this year to control inflation.

Data & Insights.title: India clears 642 UK car imports under FTA tariff quota as first allocations roll out
Data & Insights.summary: India has approved imports of 642 UK-origin cars under the newly enacted India-UK CETA tariff-rate quota. Seven of the eight applicants received these allocations, with concessional duties eventually dropping to 10%.

Data & Insights.title: EPFO ceiling reset after 12 years;  ₹25,000 threshold to cover 5.1 million more workers
Data & Insights.summary: The EPFO has increased its wage ceiling for the first time in 12 years to ₹25,000, bringing 5.1 million additional workers under mandatory social security coverage. While this expands benefits, it will also increase contribution costs for both employers and the affected employees.

Data & Insights.title: India-New Zealand FTA: New Zealand clears path for trade deal –  What it means?
Data & Insights.summary: New Zealand's parliamentary approval brings the India-New Zealand Free Trade Agreement closer to implementation. The trade deal covers goods, services, investment, agriculture, mobility, and customs procedures.

Data & Insights.title: New Zealand Parliament passes legislation to implement India FTA
Data & Insights.summary: New Zealand has passed legislation to implement a landmark free trade agreement with India. The agreement could take effect in October, providing immediate duty-free access for over half of New Zealand's exports.

Data & Insights.title: It's a fake! Forged art floods Indian market as masterworks fetch record millions
Data & Insights.summary: As Indian art prices reach record millions, the market is facing a surge of forged masterworks by renowned artists like MF Husain. Experts are responding to this growing crisis by stressing the importance of provenance and increasing authentication efforts for buyers.

India.title: Anti-Pollution Crackdown Intensifies Across NCR, 150 Inspections In 15 Days
India.summary: Over a 15-day period, the Commission for Air Quality Management's Flying Squads conducted 150 targeted inspections across the National Capital Region. These inspections focused on industrial units, construction sites, and power-generation facilities as part of an intensified anti-pollution crackdown.

India.title: Punjab Ambedkar Statue Row: BJP's Vijay Sampla Injured In Clash With BSP Workers
India.summary: BJP leader Vijay Sampla was injured during a clash between BJP and BSP workers in Punjab. The altercation began following an argument over alleged remarks made against Sampla.

India.title: 17-Year-Old Girl Raped In Chhattisgarh, 4 Men Arrested: Cops
India.summary: Four men have been arrested in Chhattisgarh for the alleged sexual assault of a 17-year-old girl. Police stated that the victim was taken to a village by an acquaintance and three of his friends, where the crime took place.

India.title: 2 Dead In 2 Days During Clashes Over Ganesh Chaturthi Procession In Tamil Nadu
India.summary: Two people have died during clashes over a Ganesh Chaturthi procession in Tamil Nadu over a two-day period. The latest fatal incident occurred in the Cuddalore district villages of Keelkarapattu and Melkarapattu.

India.title: Exclusive: After Survey Flags 2,800% Pharma Profit, Tukaram Mundhe Calls For Transparency
India.summary: A survey revealed that the pharmaceutical industry charges trade margins as high as 2,800 percent. Indian official Tukaram Mundhe called these excessive profit margins unacceptable and demanded greater transparency from the industry.

India.title: In 2025, J&K Saw No Stone-Throwing Incidents, Only 1 Terrorist Recruited
India.summary: In 2025, Jammu and Kashmir recorded zero stone-throwing incidents and only one terrorist recruitment. The Defence Ministry attributed this decline to local youth abandoning violence in favor of government welfare and employment schemes.

General.title: Body found in search for missing three-year-old Noah Woods
General.summary: Police divers recovered the body of three-year-old Noah Woods from a pond. The child had been missing since disappearing from a playground on Tuesday.

General.title: US interest rates raised for first time in three years
General.summary: The US central bank raised interest rates for the first time in three years in a unanimous decision. President Donald Trump strongly opposed the hike and had previously called for a rate cut.

General.title: 'Grief can colour memory': Palace responds after Earl Spencer's claim in Diana book
General.summary: Buckingham Palace responded to a claim in Earl Spencer's new book that the then-Prince of Wales said Princess Diana would be forgotten shortly after her death. The Palace suggested that grief can alter memory.

General.title: New hope for breast cancer patients as life-extending drug now on NHS in England
General.summary: A new life-extending breast cancer drug called Enhertu is now available on the NHS in England. The medication provides patients with an average of seven additional months to live.

General.title: Interest rates hold expected but Bank of England facing tough choices
General.summary: Forecasts of further rises in the inflation rate mean some analysts expect the Bank to act by the end of the year.
